verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
All who are thirsty, all who are weak
Come to the fountain
Dip your heart in the stream of life

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Let the pain and the sorrow be washed away
In the waves of His mercy
As deep cries out to deep

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:

Come, Lord Jesus, come

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
Holy Spirit, come
Holy Spirit, come

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
As deep cries out to deep
As deep cries out to deep

verse.name: c3
verse.lines:
Abba Father, come
Abba Father, come

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Let the sin and the sorrow be washed away
In the waves of His mercy
As deep cries out to deep
